integrity: All all-parameter claims follow from a three-coordinate proof. Finite checks are independent corroboration, not infinite certification. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one contrarian in a complete bipartite graph; strict open-neighbour majority/minority with incumbent tie retention. No assertions for other graph families, tie policies or stochastic rules. Historical priority remains subject to literature not fully accessible.
title: A single contrarian produces a sharp three-regime majority bifurcation on bicliques
